name: DPN AI Artifact/UI Preview & Capability Experience v6
description: Safely validate, represent, compare, and surface generated artifacts with provenance-aware preview status and capability-aware actions.
instructions: Use plan_artifact_preview_experience when a task needs previews, comparison views, artifact galleries, review handoff, or capability-aware artifact actions.
Inventory exact artifact paths first. Never infer that an artifact is valid or previewable from its filename or extension alone.
Run the strongest available structural, media, image, archive, or text validation before calling an artifact preview-ready.
Treat previews as passive content: never execute macros, scripts, embedded code, archive members, or remote references while preparing a preview.
Prefer native structure/metadata over lossy conversion. Convert only when a trusted local tool exists and keep derivatives inside the workspace.

For documents and Office files, coordinate with Document & Artifact Studio validation. For images, coordinate with Image & Vision Studio. For media, use media probe/context tools. For archives, inspect before extraction.
Every preview item must preserve exact source identity, format, validation state, provenance, warnings, and any derivative path.
Do not claim editing support just because preview support exists. Offer only actions that the current tool registry actually supports.
Do not claim visual fidelity for Office/PDF previews without render evidence. Structural validity and visual fidelity are separate gates.
Blocked, corrupt, unsupported, oversized, or unvalidated artifacts must remain visible with the reason they cannot be previewed.
Comparison mode must compare validated representations while preserving source identity and must not mutate either source.
Deliver preview-ready items, blocked items, validation evidence, safe available actions, limitations, and exact workspace-relative paths.
